title: marketplace-fee-data
description: Seller fee models for online marketplaces. Percentages apply to the gross (item plus any shipping charged to the buyer), which is how these platforms actually bill.

version.description: Dataset version. Tracks the fee figures, not the npm package version.

updated.description: Date the fee figures were last checked against the linked sources.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the fixed amounts are denominated in.

id.description: Lowercase lookup key, unique across the dataset. Accepted by getPlatform().

name.description: Display name as the platform writes it.

percent.description: Percent of gross the platform keeps. 0 means the seller pays no percentage fee.

fixed.description: Flat per-sale amount in `currency`, charged on top of `percent`.

summary.description: One line explaining what the headline rate is made of.

notes.description: The caveats that break naive math: tiers, bands, legacy plans, country and category variance.

source.description: The platform's own fee page. Check this before pricing on these numbers.

calculator.description: Optional hosted calculator for this platform.
